newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria seeks 150,000 tonnes soft wheat - traders.
newsitem.headline: Algeria seeks 150,000 tonnes soft wheat - traders.

text.p: Algeria launched a tender on Tuesday for the purchase of 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat for shipment in the second half of August and in September, European grain traders said.
Algeria is seeking wheat from the U.S. and/or Canada and/or Argentina and/or the European Union, excluding Britain, they said.
Exporters provided the following shipment dates-
Last week Algeria bought 150,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat for shipment in July and August. One exporter had pegged the purchase at around $165 per tonne on a cost and freight basis.
